title: Ang Mo Kio Library reopens at AMK Hub featuring double-volume space, Immersive Hub, Singapore News

 singapore Ang Mo Kio Library reopens at AMK Hub featuring double-volume space, Immersive Hub
 The library also has more seats when compared to its former home at 4300 Ang Mo Kio Avenue 6. Tall wall bookshelves line Ang Mo Kio Library’s double-volume space. PHOTO: Ministry of Digital Development and Information. PUBLISHED ON November 20, 2026 7:30 PM BY Sean Ler The revamped Ang Mo Kio Library opened its doors again on Nov 20 (Friday) at AMK Hub. 
 The new premises on the fourth floor of the hub, which used to house a cinema, now boasts double-volume space with design elements and new interactive experiences that brings the neighbourhood’s heritage to life.
 The National Library Board (NLB) said on Friday that the revamped library now offers more cost spaces to read and gather, complemented by nostalgic design elements and new interactive experiences.
 This, it added, could encourage patrons of all ages to discover the joy of reading, Singapore stories, share memories and connect across generations.
 More space for reading, connecting
 The library also has more seats when compared to its former two-storey home at 4300 Ang Mo Kio Avenue 6.
 The new library features spaces for reading, individual study, and building connections, including seven nooks suitable for collaborative study or co-working sessions, which are bookable via NLB’s seat booking system.
 The verticality of the library's double-volume space is highlighted by the floor-to-ceiling bookshelves that line the library walls, with higher shelves displaying over 5,500 pre-loved books.
 "As patrons enter this haven of books, they can browse the shelves, and look at the displayed titles to find inspiration for their next read," NLB said.
 Lotus pad-inspired curved ceiling features and table furnishings draw inspiration from the former lotus pond at Ang Mo Kio Town Garden West, creating a serene and calm atmosphere in the reading and studying space. PHOTO: NLB Discovering Ang Mo Kio's history
 Meanwhile, a six-metre structure is home to an Immersive Hub that NLB said will bring Ang Mo Kio's history and Singapore stories to life.
 The hub's exterior is lined with pre-loved books.
 The Immersive Hub’s curved exterior is lined with pre-loved books, doubling as a book display to inspire patrons on their next read. PHOTO: NLB It also boasts a 360-degree curved screen, showcasing digital experiences exclusive to Ang Mo Kio Library.
 On what patrons can look forward to, NLB said: "From a cinematic film that traces Ang Mo Kio’s evolution, to an interactive feature that animates archival photos of Ang Mo Kio, these digital experiences bring NLB's wealth of archival resources to life, taking patrons on an immersive journey through Ang Mo Kio's past, present, and future."
 The Immersive Hub features a 360-degree curved screen and surround sound technology for a seamless audiovisual experience. PHOTO: NLB Other features at the library include an 18-metre-long augmented reality-activated Singapore Collection Mural — an art installation depicting several familiar sights of Ang Mo Kio’s past and present like the former Broadway Cinema building, a children zone, and nature-inspired study and multimedia areas. 
 NLB chief executive Melissa Tam said the revamped Ang Mo Kio Library drew inspiration from the neighbourhood's familiar landmarks and rich heritage to create a space that represents Ang Mo Kio,
 "We hope that this will inspire communities to come together to read, share experiences, and connect across generations, proving that libraries are more than just spaces for reading and learning," she added.
 Minister for Digital Development and Information Josephine Teo officiated at the library's opening on Friday.
